title: FDA rebukes Baxter over 'repeated' production stumbles in new warning letter
llm_note: The FDA issued a warning letter to Baxter regarding repeated production violations at their facilities.

title: Samsung Bio union to contest court ruling blocking worker strikes
llm_note: A labor union is contesting a court ruling that currently blocks strikes at a contract manufacturing facility.

title: LGM Pharma Acquires Sannova Analytical, Expanding cGMP Analytical and GLP Bioanalytical Services
llm_note: LGM Pharma acquired Sannova Analytical to build a U.S.-based cGMP analytical services platform.

title: iPSC Manufacturing Starts with the Source
llm_note: Pluristyx identifies the use of clinical-grade starting materials as critical for successful commercial-scale iPSC manufacturing.

title: Raman+NIR Spectra Improves Glucose Soft Sensing
llm_note: A multimodal soft-sensing framework using Raman and NIR spectroscopy improves glucose monitoring in commercial-scale bioprocessing.

title: Patients Should Be Considered When Choosing a Vector Production Method
llm_note: Thermo Fisher Scientific study highlights that manufacturing method selection for viral vectors significantly impacts gene therapy production costs.
